name: First Arrival

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 8 / title.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 8 / route6.

recognitionRules: Pair Baskerville or Georgia reading titles with Avenir labels.
Use a warm ivory field, muted blue accents and a stable footer rule.
Keep chapter numbers and margin evidence notes visible.
Separate illustrative imagery from the actual evidence of a design decision.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: The first five minutes deserve a clear path.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use FIRST ARRIVAL in a serif wordmark with a small Avenir reading-edition line. A short margin rule may accompany it; no location pin.
invariants: Pair Baskerville or Georgia reading titles with Avenir labels.
Use a warm ivory field, muted blue accents and a stable footer rule.
Keep chapter numbers and margin evidence notes visible.
adaptations: A digital version retains chapter and margin-note relationships.
A short extract includes the context and contribution before the proposed result.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Baskerville is a separately licensed/system font; not bundled.
Avenir Next is a separately licensed Apple/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
